title: Glass – Shower Screens, Mirrors & Balustrades
status: Draft spot check from ITPs – for agreement

questions.q: Openings surveyed square and plumb before manufacture (frames fit without packing out)?
Laser level and tape calibrated (±2 mm over 10 m)?
Fire-rated glass (where scheduled) shows its etched mark?
Ask the fitter: How is the screen sealed to the stone and tray? Could they answer?
questions.source: SuperPrime site practice – a fitter who can't answer is a red flag

questions.q: Glass undamaged, with safety marking visible?
10% of structural fixings torque-checked and pull-out tested?
Setting blocks/packers in place and undamaged; silicone neat, continuous and tooled flat?
Doors swing freely, self-close where designed, no catching on stone or walls?

notOk.t: Protective film, tape or stickers left on mirrors and glass
Mirror doors not flush / uneven margins
Poor joint where screen meets stone or wall
Grout or mastic missing at the screen base
Mirror LEDs not fitted or not working
Screen handle clashing with the wall
